database.stem: Payment of telephone or Internet orders is ------- within 7 working days of the receipt of the goods and invoice.
database.raw_text:
Payment of telephone or Internet orders is ------- within 7 working days of the
receipt of the goods and invoice.
(A) due
(B) coming
(C) payable
(D) complete
database.explanation:
句意应为“应在收到货物和发票后7个工作日内付款”，故选
(A) due (应支付的)。
